alternative_explanations: Any apparent shared gain may come from reconstructing the finite evaluator map or exploiting the common Feistel interface rather than discovering generally transferable mechanisms.
Exact MDL enumeration may recover the same finite module library more cheaply, making the learned parameterization scientifically redundant.
confounds: Any train/test composition overlap, public-shape leakage, module/source/native labels, oracle graph access, target access, seed leakage, post-score tuning, semantic-baseline mismatch, state-budget breach or evaluator digest change invalidates the cohort.
falsification_criteria: Discard the exact shared mechanism if held-out accuracy is below 0.95, minimum-combination accuracy is below 0.90, or either source-identical independent/no-cross ablation is within 0.10 accuracy.

Discard the exact shared mechanism if an implementable finite-order, nearest-template or exact-MDL control matches its capability while no worse on every declared acquisition, fit/search, query, update, state, bytes and R16 axis.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any overlap between registered training and held-out compositions.
Invalidate if module IDs, source families, native types, extraction paths or the composition graph reach an implementable candidate.
Invalidate if public support, query or target shapes identify a composition above chance plus 0.10.
Invalidate if scoring-state conjugation or support partitions are realized before integrity and source audit.
Invalidate on target access, scoring-seed leakage, post-score tuning, state-budget breach or evaluator-integrity change.

outcome_policy.negative: A crash rejects only the implementation; a leakage, semantic-control, seed or integrity failure invalidates the experiment and permits no scientific interpretation.
outcome_policy.null: A valid null makes this exact shared learner dormant without tuning the frozen interface, composition split, support size, state cap or controls.
outcome_policy.positive: A valid one-seed result meeting every quality, ablation and Pareto gate justifies only preregistering a three-seed adversarial replication; it does not support promotion or broad successor claims.

predicted_outcome: The shared learner will probably recover some reusable structure but exact MDL search may match it; a scientifically positive quick requires at least 0.95 held-out accuracy, 0.90 minimum-combination accuracy, at least 0.10 accuracy advantage over both causal ablations, and implementable Pareto non-dominance.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote; a valid positive result may authorize only a three-seed adversarial screen with a new held-out ordered combination and intact semantic/integrity gates.
research_question: Can one shared family-blind module-induction rule recover the unseen ordered CB composition with better held-out accuracy per fully charged cost than source-identical independent and no-sharing ablations plus finite-order, template and exact-MDL controls?
title: Shared latent mechanism library on held-out ordered recombination
